intro2.title: Toymaker Escape
intro2.p1: A late evening at the atelier.

e1.title: Toymaker Escape — Episode 1
e1.body: A quiet workshop. Clues hide in plain sight.

keypad.hint: A clue in the room seems to suggest the order... study the toys on the shelf.

gears.instruction: Adjust the gears to achieve a 1:3 ratio (output = 1/3 of input speed).

panel.title: Panel (wires & pipes)
panel.pipesHint: Rotate tiles; valve must be open.

latch.hint: Hint: long‑press then drag on the scuff to reveal a latch.

filing.title: Filing Logic
filing.prompt: Sort each toy into the correct cabinet based on the clues.
filing.hint: Dolls go to Cabinet A, cars to Cabinet B, puzzles to Cabinet C.
filing.sorted: All toys sorted correctly! The filing-cabinet key turns.

shadow.title: Shadow Safe
shadow.prompt: Align the shapes to cast the correct shadow pattern on the wall.
shadow.hint: Drag each shape until the combined shadow matches the safe's keyhole pattern.
shadow.solved: The shadow aligns perfectly. The safe clicks open.

wrap.title: Episode 2 Complete
wrap.body: The office secrets are revealed. You found the commissioner's notes.

intro.title: Apartment Mystery
intro.body: You arrive at your own apartment. Something feels off. The commissioner left clues here — but why YOUR apartment?

locks.title: Environmental Locks
locks.prompt: Trigger the objects in the right sequence: water, sunlight, soil.

photos.title: Photo Memory Wall
photos.prompt: Three photos are pinned to the wall. Identify the two that are connected.
photos.found: You found the connection! The commissioner and the toymaker share a link.

anagram.title: Fridge Anagram
anagram.prompt: The fridge magnets spell a scrambled word. Rearrange them to unlock the cool storage.

wrap.title: Episode 3 Complete
wrap.body: The apartment mystery is solved. The commissioner WAS the toymaker — you created this puzzle for yourself.
